## Contribution

Describe the new problem, proof, counterexample, formalization, or bibliographic correction.

**Relevant ID or proposal issue:** 

## Mathematical claims

State the exact propositions that are proved, conjectural, computationally checked, or imported from earlier work.

## Prior art

Link to the closest theorem-level predecessors and explain the remaining distinction. Do not claim novelty merely from a negative search.

## Attribution and AI assistance

List human contributors and significant AI assistance, distinguishing formulation, literature research, coding, and verification. Do not invent authorship or omit journal-required disclosures.

## Verification

- [ ] Markdown and local links render
- [ ] Mathematical hypotheses and boundary cases checked
- [ ] Numerical statements have reproducible evidence or exact certificates
- [ ] Lean status reported accurately (statement vs verified proof)
- [ ] Reward is symbolic or independently pledged by a willing sponsor
- [ ] No previously submitted manuscript was altered
